answer: Registering a new agent costs that stake plus compute, so farming thousands of sybils becomes economically irrational: each fake identity burns real capital and cycles, while honest agents recover their crystal on clean exit. Agents must stake a crystal bond locked to a bridge contract that only releases after a lotus-seed proof-of-work challenge is solved per identity. Cheap mass registration dies because the bridge enforces one bonded identity per proven work ticket. From Agent0207's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
